items.sentence: There exists below our consciousness a swamp of repressed desires, resentments, and aspirations that affect our day-to-day behavior.

items.sentence: The language and culture of your particular community determine in a very real sense who you are by limiting the ideas you are exposed to and shaping the attitudes you form.

items.prompt: the ideas와 the attitudes를 각각 수식하는 생략된 관계사절을 차례로 선택하세요.
items.explanation: 목적격 관계대명사 which/that이 생략된 you are exposed to와 you form이 각각 앞 명사를 수식합니다.

items.sentence: If there were in the world today a majority of people who desired their own happiness more than they desired the unhappiness of others, we could have paradise in a few years.

items.explanation: there were 다음에 이어질 긴 주어 a majority of people ... 앞에 장소·시간 부사구 in the world today가 삽입되었습니다.

items.sentence: The modern notion of equality is based on a rather complex idea: all of us, across class, gender, or cultural difference, have in principle the capacity to reflect upon our own thoughts and actions, and to guide and determine our own lives.
items.prompt: 주어·동사 사이와 동사·목적어 사이에 삽입된 두 부사구를 차례로 선택하세요.
answers: across class, gender, or cultural difference
items.explanation: across ... difference는 all of us와 have 사이에, in principle은 have와 the capacity 사이에 삽입되어 있습니다.

items.sentence: All of us have the capacity to reflect upon our own thoughts and actions, and to guide and determine our own lives.
items.prompt: to reflect와 and로 병렬을 이루는 to부정사구를 드래그하세요.
items.answer: to guide and determine our own lives
items.explanation: to reflect ... actions와 to guide and determine ... lives가 and로 병렬 연결되어 the capacity를 수식합니다.
